page.layout: One page of text. Top: ornamental border, then a centred dedication title in several lines (Latin, with a Greek line and the signature "LEO"). Below: one body paragraph in italic, ending with "vale.". Bottom right: catchword "POLI-". Below it: ornamental border. No margins, no running head, no page number.

main_text.l: Domino & Sympatriotae suo eximie honorando; φιλίας [?] καὶ φιλοσοφίας [?] LEO ἀπραξίας τε [?] ὑγίειαν.

l.i: Tot tantaq; beneficia, Illustris & Cl. D. Doctor, à
MO, studiorum optimorum fautore & Mecœnate incompa-
rabili, per vestram splendidissimam Familiam in me huc-
usq; collata sunt, & quotidie conferuntur, ut dignissimus
sane essem, qui exularem ab omni penitus humanitate,
si non ego vicissim vel animum (si plurib. pro tempore nō
licet) gratum saltem & benevolum benefactorib. declar-
em. Et proin tibi etiā, mi D. Doctor Iseli, hæcce Medico-
iuridica offerenda duxi, debitæ observātiæ, amoris &
gratitudinis meæ erga familiā quoq; vestrā signū &
μνημόσυνον. Quæ ut sereno & candido animo suscipias, excipias
& tuearis, ac Leonem porrò tuum, tibi in perpetuum
devinctum, siquidem dignum ducis, ut abs te ametur, re-
damare ut incipias, vel potius pergas, rogo. Etiam atq;

page.notes: Greek line "φιλίας [?] καὶ φιλοσοφίας [?]" and "ἀπραξίας τε [?] ὑγίειαν." are uncertain in the ornamental symbols and accents; the word "Medico-" is hyphenated at the line end and joined here. "ROTERODA / MO" has no printed hyphen and is written whole. The body text is set in italic throughout; the abbreviation "nō" is copied with its macron as printed.
